description: This file contains logging utility functions for the 'jwql' automation platform, including configuration of logs, decorators for logging execution info, timing, and failure handling, and functions for managing log files and environment information.

methods.name: configure_logging
methods.description: Configures the logging system for a specified module, setting up a log file and permissions.

methods.name: get_log_status
methods.description: Reads a log file to determine if the script completed successfully or failed.

methods.name: make_log_file
methods.description: Generates a log filename and path based on the module name, timestamp, and environment.

methods.name: log_info
methods.description: Decorator that logs system environment information and execution time of a wrapped function.

methods.name: log_fail
methods.description: Decorator that catches exceptions in a wrapped function, logging tracebacks and failure status.

methods.name: log_timing
methods.description: Decorator that measures and logs the execution time of a function.
